The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError because cells H46 through L47 returned '#NAME?' instead of the expected numerical values. This error typically indicates a typo in a formula name or a reference to a non-existent range. While the 'net metric' matrix passed, the 'statistics' block mismatches included errors like 'H46: expected -3.5737762237762265, got #NAME?'. Avoid using unsupported Excel functions or incorrect named ranges in openpyxl.
